definitions.explanation: a moderate flame or heat setting used in cooking, between low and high heat

examples.japanese: {中火|ちゅうび}で{炒|いた}める。
{中火|ちゅうび}で{五分|ごふん}{焼|や}く。
examples.english: Grill on medium heat for 5 minutes.

examples.japanese: フライパンを{中火|ちゅうび}で{温|あたた}める。
examples.english: Heat the frying pan on medium heat.

examples.japanese: {強火|つよび}から{中火|ちゅうび}に{落|お}とす。
examples.english: Reduce from high to medium heat.

examples.japanese: {中火|ちゅうび}でじっくり{両面|りょうめん}を{焼|や}く。
examples.english: Grill both sides thoroughly on medium heat.

notes:
{中火|ちゅうび} is the standard medium heat setting used in Japanese cooking. It is the most commonly called-for heat level in recipes.

COMPOUND: {中|ちゅう} (middle) + {火|び} (fire/heat)

HEAT LEVELS IN COOKING:
- {弱火|よわび}: low heat (simmering, delicate dishes)
- {中火|ちゅうび}: medium heat (general cooking)
- {強火|つよび}: high heat (searing, stir-fry)
- とろ{火|び}: very low heat (slow cooking)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {中火|ちゅうび}にする: to set to medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}で{焼|や}く: to grill on medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}で{煮|に}る: to simmer on medium heat
- {中火|ちゅうび}に{落|お}とす: to reduce to medium heat
